findings.description: `wf_wind_convergence_idx_xy` and its cached variant now produce a signed net-inflow ratio with a median near 0.016, but cyclone genesis, the cyclone bridge, and storm-wake injection still use convergence cutoffs of 0.30 or 0.34 calibrated to the old metric. When convergence is below those cutoffs and instability does not satisfy the alternative gate—including ocean storm centers below 0.55 instability—cyclone births and storm-wake current perturbations are suppressed without changes to their own settings.
findings.title: Tropical cyclones form far less often after the rain retune

evidence.explanation: The convergence calculation changed from a positive-inflow average to net inflow minus outflow, moving the median from roughly 0.376 to 0.016; the new 90th percentile is about 0.458. Other field-solver consumers were recalibrated, but the cyclone genesis gate at `gdext/src/runtime_climate_passes_cyclone.cpp:123-127`, the bridge gate at `gdext/src/runtime_climate_cyclone_bridge.cpp:383`, and the storm-wake gate at `Project/project-keynes/scripts/weather/front_advect.gd:124-125` retain old cutoffs. The former 0.30 cutoff was near the old minimum, while the unchanged wake gate requires at least 0.34 convergence when instability is below 0.55.

findings.description: Only `earth_like.tres` sets `weather_precip_classify_gate_land/water` (0.095/0.076). `earth_like_mobile_complex.tres` sets neither, so it falls back to the `ClimateProfile` defaults of 0.040/0.032. Meanwhile the classifier now requires all four of precipitation rate, cloud, cloud water and vapour to pass, and STORM and MONSOON now also require that check. As a result, mobile games use a precipitation calibration the PR documents as valid for neither preset, and rain, storm and monsoon frequencies differ from desktop on the same world.
findings.title: Mobile Earth preset keeps the old rain gates
